The '''Starveil Project''' was a project that was undertaken by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[4067 BBY]], to search the [[Luire system]].

==The project==
Officially, the aim of the project was to explore and search for [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species. However, in reality, the project was put together to search for an experimental [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] vessel that had gone missing near the Luire system. To carry out the project, [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bethanie Melan]] of the Republic Navy was assigned to command the [[Starveil (starship)|''Starveil'']], a civilian exploration ship, and use it to scan the Luire system for any sign of the missing vessel. However, while undertaking the mission, the ''Starveil'' crash-landed on [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]], the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].
